contentBlocks.body: A question mark after a parameter name makes it optional: greeting?: string. Inside the function the value is either the passed string or undefined, so you handle the missing case explicitly.

knowledgeItems.prompt: What marks a parameter as optional in TypeScript?

payload.explanation: greeting?: string makes greeting optional; its type becomes string | undefined.

payload.text: An optional parameter may be the given value or ____ when the caller omits it.
